personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (adapted for precise, clinical lab tool)
personality_one_liner: A structured, clinical, and precise interface that prioritizes data density, workflow speed, and reliability at the bench.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content to allow deep focus. Never flush to screen edge; always minimum md margin. Stack related metrics close (sm/md), divide separate sections generously (lg/xl).

navigation: drawer (left navigation drawer on all platforms, hamburger toggle on mobile)

do's: Use on the top app bar when scrolling content flows behind it.
Use for sticky summary sheets floating at the bottom during Formula Builder.
dont's: Do not use on list rows, formula cards, or dense numeric dashboard panels.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A command-center entry point showing quick actions and recent bench-work.

states.loading: Skeleton grids mapping to the tile layout.
states.empty: No recent formulas. Central empty-state with primary CTA 'Build New Formula'.

screens.layout: Grid-based modular layout. Top header with search. A 'Quick Actions' section with 2-column or 3-column large tiles (Calculate, Builder, Lookup). Below, a 'Recent History' vertical list of last edited formulas with primary KPIs (e.g., pH, viscosity) visible in the list item.

screens.name: Formula Builder
screens.purpose: A precision input environment to author and tweak chemical compositions.

states.empty: Start from scratch or select a template.

screens.layout: Form-style input with labeled fields. Segmented controls for unit selection. List of added ingredients mapping to percent composition. Sticky 'Save / Analyze' primary CTA bottom bar inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Formula Checker
screens.purpose: Validation and compliance review for a specific formulation.
screens.layout: Result cards showing calculated safety values prominently. Secondary details formatted as key-value pairs. Visual status badges (success/warning/error) next to compliance metrics.

screens.name: Formula Analyzer
screens.purpose: Deep dive into the physical properties and cost of the formula.
screens.layout: Heavy use of surfaceSecondary panels wrapping metric groupings (Cost per batch, Expected Viscosity, Solvents ratio). Use progress-bar style composition visualizers.

screens.name: Ingredient Library
screens.purpose: Searchable database of raw chemical materials.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty folder. 'No ingredients match search'.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top. Segmented filters (Surfactants, Builders, Solvents) that pin under the header. Tappable list rows (min 56pt height) detailing name and CAS number.

screens.name: Formula Library
screens.purpose: Archive of saved recipes and templates for easy retrieval.

states.empty: Clean desk illustration. 'Your library is empty. Save a formula to see it here.'

screens.layout: Tabbed view (Favorites, All, Templates). Grid of cards or dense list depending on screen size. Each card highlights the formula name, creation date, and primary function.

screens.name: AI Formula Expert
screens.purpose: Chat-based assistant to help troubleshoot formulation instability or suggest substitutions.

states.empty: Prompt suggestions: 'Suggest a milder surfactant', 'Why is my formula separating?'

screens.layout: Chat interface. Messages sit in rounded surfaceTertiary (received) and brandTertiary (sent) bubbles. Sticky text input pinned to keyboard.

screens.name: PDF Reports
screens.purpose: Export center for generating batch sheets and compliance documents.

states.empty: Select a formula to generate a report.

screens.layout: List of available templates (Batch Sheet, Safety Data Sheet, Cost Breakdown). A preview pane and a sticky 'Export' primary CTA.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Standard iOS-style grouped list. Sections separated by generous spacing. Toggles for Dark Mode, Unit Preferences (Metric/Imperial).

hero_abstract_chemistry.alt: Abstract blue background with clear tubes and cubes representing modern chemistry

empty_library.alt: Clean wooden desk with a white notebook, representing an empty workspace

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the left navigation drawer requirement as requested. Build a persistent sidebar on Desktop and a Drawer/Hamburger approach on Mobile/Tablet.
Do NOT use bottom tabs. All primary navigation exists in the drawer.
The application theme strictly uses the Emerald/Viridian green palette provided. Do not revert to default Tailwind blues or purples.

Pages should initially be built as foundational layouts with placeholders (breadcrumbs, titles, and empty states). Refer to the 'screens' layout instructions to scaffold the structural empty views correctly.

Make use of standard React/Tailwind/Vite architecture (this is a PWA web application, despite native design patterns, we adapt iOS-Native clean concepts to Tailwind). Ensure the top app bar has a theme toggle and hamburger menu.
For the Dashboard empty state, build a realistic grid scaffold of cards (even if empty) to show the intended 'lab bench' layout.
